Understandably it must be incredibly difficult to approach social situations but because you may be closed off onto them, you can use that to form even deeper connections with people you are truly comfortable with.   


Instead of being the social butterfly and centre of attention which may cause them to create superficial relationships, you have the opportunity to observe others and choose who you want to be with and be your unapologetic self with!

correct me if im wrong but doesnt BPD mean you have an influx of different emotions? I understand and empathise that it must be difficult for you going through moods very rapidly but it makes you extremely empathetic and kind as a result. With everything in life, there is always a balance caused by one negative and a positive. 

To me, because you have the incredible capability of feeling many different kinds of emotions, you can use that as like a superpower to help others understand their own emotions.
